headword: {再生|さいせい}{回数|かいすう}

definitions.gloss: view count; number of plays; playback count
definitions.explanation: The number of times a video or audio file has been played. A key metric on video platforms like YouTube and music streaming services.

examples.japanese: {再生|さいせい}{回数|かいすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The view count exceeded one million.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再生|さいせい}{回数|かいすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: This video has a low view count.

examples.japanese: {再生|さいせい}{回数|かいすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧ほど⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧になっている。
examples.english: The system is set up so that videos with more views earn more advertising revenue.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard term in online media and social networking. Essential vocabulary for discussing YouTube, TikTok, and other video platforms in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再生|さいせい}{回数|かいすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧／⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ (high/low view count)
- {再生|さいせい}{回数|かいすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧ (to rack up views)
- {再生|さいせい}{回数|かいすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ (view count grows)
- ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧{再生|さいせい}{回数|かいすう} (total view count)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{閲覧|えつらん}→閲覧：17691_etsuran⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: page views — for web pages rather than videos
- ⟦{視聴|しちょう}{率|りつ}→視聴率：08381_shichouritsu⟧: viewer ratings — for television programs
